items.statement: The submission executes a reproducible optimization and frequency workflow for both public fixed geometries and states charge/multiplicity.
items.expected: Both structures have documented optimization/frequency outcomes and computational settings.

items.statement: The target is tested as a first-order saddle and the reported imaginary mode is connected to the specified N–O cleavage endpoint.
items.expected: One imaginary frequency and atom/bond displacement evidence are reported.

items.statement: The report gives the fixed-pair Gibbs barrier in kcal/mol with an explicit equation and limitations.
items.expected: A numerical barrier or scientifically justified bounded failure is supplied.
